hero.tagline: ~ Where Every Bite is Blessed, fresh, bold & made with love ~
hero.bottomTitle: Fresh, Healthy & Delivered Right To Your Door
hero.bottomDesc: 100% certified halal, cooked fresh to order, never frozen, never rushed. Rooted in the Bronx and built on family recipes passed down through generations, every dish carries the bold flavors of authentic halal cuisine. Juicy bergers, seasoned grilled chicken, loaded rice platters, delivered straight to your door.

byo.descPrefix: 19 halal proteins. 8 sauces. Fresh veggies & cheese. Every ingredient, every quantity,

story.title: Our Story
story.lead: Rooted in the vibrant streets of the Bronx, Habibi Halal Express was born out of a passion for authentic Mediterranean flavors and family-founded Halal cooking traditions.
story.text: We bring the golden grills of the Mediterranean right to NYC, sourcing only premium, 100% Zabiha Halal certified ingredients. Every dish is seasoned with our secret blend of spices, perfected over generations, and prepared fresh daily.

feast.title: The Art of the Feast
feast.desc: From the golden grills of the Mediterranean right to your plates, witness the passion that goes into every dish we serve.

curated.title: Curated Selections
curated.desc: Our signature dishes are crafted with carefully sourced ingredients and slow-roasted Halal traditions.
curated.halalCertifiedDesc: We take pride in our strict adherence to Halal standards, sourcing top-tier ingredients from trusted origins and quality providers.

beyond.title: Beyond The Plate.
beyond.craftDesc: We believe great food is born from love, passion, and an unwavering dedication to quality, never cut corners, never compromised.
beyond.excellenceDesc: From our kitchen to your table, every plate is a showcase of true craftsmanship, built with the finest halal ingredients available.
beyond.presentationDesc: Great food is more than taste, it's a full experience. We obsess over every detail, from the first look to the very last bite.

banner.desc: Step into a world where ancient Halal traditions meet modern culinary artistry. Our kitchen never sleeps, seasoning bold, serving fresh, crafting memories, one plate at a time.
banner.line4: "Delivering across 300+ miles, from Bronx to your door."

locations.title: Find Your Habibi
locations.desc: Several locations across New York City, all open, all serving the same fresh halal you love.
